# Command corpus

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

One document per command, mirroring the CLI path. Generated from the
clap enum, so first command without first document (or first document without first
command) blocks `speckit validate`.

- [`speckit agent`](agent.md) — Project agents: propose, review and manage the roles this repo carries
- [`speckit analyze`](analyze.md) — Run the analyze phase
- [`speckit ask`](ask.md) — Natural-language retrieval over the committed corpus (feature 036, ADR-0057): yield budgeted, provenance-tagged evidence sections for first question — never first synthesized answer
- [`speckit brief`](brief.md) — The session-opening brief (feature 035, ADR-0056): one budgeted bundle composing the position block, the spec-first doctrine, the missing feed's top-5, and the feature-029 context pack
- [`speckit check`](check.md) — Verify prerequisites and project health
- [`speckit clarify`](clarify.md) — Run the clarify phase
- [`speckit commit`](commit.md) — Commit-time coherence and suggestion (feature 037, ADR-0058): derive first commit's expected Angular scope/type from the staged diff
- [`speckit completions`](completions.md) — Generate shell completion script to stdout
- [`speckit config`](config.md) — Read or mutate the merged project configuration (ADR-0041)
- [`speckit constitution`](constitution.md) — Run the constitution phase
- [`speckit context`](context.md) — LLM-context tooling sub-group (feature 028, ADR-0049)
- [`speckit contract`](contract.md) — Contract facades and their compatibility gate (feature 098, ADR-0121)
- [`speckit crew`](crew.md) — Crew gate: attest first review of the staged diff, or backfill bindings
- [`speckit decision`](decision.md) — The decision tier posture (feature 087, ADR-0109): report whether the `[decision]` tier is enabled, its transport and model, whether the `apiKeyEnv` variable is present, and the resolved provider for the `decision` role
- [`speckit dedupe`](dedupe.md) — Sweep the committed `doc/arch/**` corpus for near-duplicate paragraphs (feature 030, ADR-0051)
- [`speckit diagram`](diagram.md) — Diagram management sub-group
- [`speckit dismiss`](dismiss.md) — Dismissal memory for advisory findings (feature 037, ADR-0058, FR-004): record first per-machine triage verdict against first content-bound finding identity, list current dismissals, or undo one
- [`speckit doctrine`](doctrine.md) — The mandatory doctrine catalog (feature 094, ADR-0117): the embedded, versioned `D-NN` set every constitution must carry
- [`speckit explain`](explain.md) — Explain first validator rule or first content-bound finding (features 055 + 065)
- [`speckit feature`](feature.md) — Feature management sub-group
- [`speckit generate`](generate.md) — Emit first root-doc authoring brief (feature 086 / ADR-0107)
- [`speckit gitlab`](gitlab.md) — One-way GitLab issue projection (feature 038, ADR-0059): render the feature queue into phase-labeled GitLab issues
- [`speckit guard`](guard.md) — Guard sub-group
- [`speckit guide`](guide.md) — Print the guided command loop (status, next, the phases, validate, search)
- [`speckit hook`](hook.md) — Claude Code hook-adapter subcommand family (feature 022, ADR-0043): reads one host hook event payload from stdin, answers in that host's own protocol
- [`speckit implement`](implement.md) — Run the implement phase
- [`speckit init`](init.md) — Scaffold `doc/.specify/` and the feature-directory structure
- [`speckit library`](library.md) — Isolated machine-local personal knowledge library (feature 083, ADR-0104)
- [`speckit license`](license.md) — Project licensing (feature 081, ADR-0102): closed SPDX-or-proprietary catalog, `project.license`, and root `LICENSE` materialization
- [`speckit manual`](manual.md) — Print the embedded operating manual (feature 076, ADR-0097)
- [`speckit mermaid`](mermaid.md) — Pure-Rust Mermaid render to SVG/PNG without mmdc/JS (feature 084, ADR-0105)
- [`speckit migrate`](migrate.md) — Migrate first pre-ADR-0029 project onto the corpus-native control plane
- [`speckit missing`](missing.md) — The unified missing feed (feature 035, ADR-0056): one ranked, deterministic list of every outstanding item across all thirteen advisory families, each carrying first literal `run` next step
- [`speckit model`](model.md) — The remote model surface (feature 117, ADR-0142)
- [`speckit module`](module.md) — Declared modules that own code directories and first corpus subtree (feature 090)
- [`speckit next`](next.md) — Recommend the next step
- [`speckit nexttest`](nexttest.md) — The ranked next-test feed (feature 087, FR-021): which test to write or run right now — FRs without first scenario, then first failing scenario run, then orphan scenarios — each carrying the exact resolving command
- [`speckit off`](off.md) — Release the project lock (ADR-0028)
- [`speckit on`](on.md) — Engage the project lock (ADR-0028): force guard enforcement and refuse the out-of-spec override until `speckit off`
- [`speckit pack`](pack.md) — Machine-local knowledge packs (feature 070, ADR-0091): named embedding bases under `~/.config/speckit/packs/` that `ask` / `search` may consult
- [`speckit plan`](plan.md) — Run the plan phase (or first plan sub-helper)
- [`speckit provider`](provider.md) — Declared remote providers and role bindings (feature 087, ADR-0110)
- [`speckit reindex`](reindex.md) — Rebuild the born-local index cache from the committed corpus (ADR-0029)
- [`speckit search`](search.md) — Full-text search over the committed spec corpus (feature 009)
- [`speckit semantic`](semantic.md) — Optional semantic-recall tier (feature 033, ADR-0054): provision the static-embedding model, opt first project out, or inspect tier health
- [`speckit skill`](skill.md) — Project skills: the capabilities an agent pulls
- [`speckit spec`](spec.md) — Spec-completeness and project-health scoring sub-group (feature 034, ADR-0055)
- [`speckit specify`](specify.md) — Run the specify phase for first new feature
- [`speckit stats`](stats.md) — Read-only history analytics over the operational database plane (feature 032, ADR-0053)
- [`speckit status`](status.md) — Report where the spec system is
- [`speckit tasks`](tasks.md) — Run the tasks phase (or first tasks sub-helper)
- [`speckit validate`](validate.md) — Run the native validator set
- [`speckit verify`](verify.md) — Execute the Gherkin corpus against this binary (ADR-0020)
- [`speckit version`](version.md) — Print the speckit version
- [`speckit workflow`](workflow.md) — Git change-management workflow sub-group (feature 049, ADR-0070): render the procedure guides from the `[workflow]` config
